practice.title: Explain-and-apply: Smart Products
steps: Explain Smart Products in writing as if teaching a beginner, without looking it up.
Apply it to a realistic example and check that your explanation held up.
Fix the explanation where your example exposed a gap.
practice.description: A self-contained exercise on Smart Products for Mechatronics Engineer. Finish it by checking that an independent reader follows the steps and reaches the same result.

projects.title: Mini-project: apply Smart Products
projects.description: Apply Smart Products for Mechatronics Engineer and produce a documented worked example whose steps someone else can reproduce. Then check that an independent reader follows the steps and reaches the same result.
projects.goal: Demonstrate working command of Smart Products by producing a documented worked example whose steps someone else can reproduce and verifying that an independent reader follows the steps and reaches the same result.
requirements: A documented worked example whose steps someone else can reproduce that genuinely applies Smart Products for Mechatronics Engineer.
Record the inputs, assumptions, and exact steps you followed.
State the evidence that it works: an independent reader follows the steps and reaches the same result.
outcomes: Working the documentation plus the working artifact.
A short written explanation of Smart Products you could defend in a review or interview.
extensions: Re-do it under one changed constraint (scale, tolerance, budget, or dataset) and compare the outcome.
